chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Northern popular style and Creath's blues
summary: Creath's band played northern stock orchestrations in the style of Isham Jones and Paul Whiteman, not New Orleans style, but Creath was famed as a soulful blues player.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: And of course you had to read because we have these little orchestrations, we have to play popular music. We weren't playing the New Orleans style of jazz, you know. We were playing the northern style, like, you know, and Charlie and Mark, Ishon Jones and --
